page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark data places the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-intensive tasks, it achieves a stress-ng multi-core score of 30666.35 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the system processes 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and handles static web serving throughput at 21.45 GB/sec. LLM inference speeds for a 7B model reach 45.98 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 12.4 tokens/sec for text generation.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation offers predictable compute performance without hyperthreading overhead, making it suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy applications. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance well-suited for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale web serving.
